title: When Trust Meets Truth: Trust-Truth Separability in LLM-as-Judge
abstract: arXiv:2608.21097v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-as-Judge systems can produce multi-dimensional evaluations, such as trustworthiness, reliability, and factuality, and these outputs are often interpreted as independent evidence. We test this assumption for a common pair of judgments: trust scoring and binary truth classification. On correctness-controlled QA, LLM judges align trust scores with truth verdicts more tightly than human behavioral reference, suggesting weaker separations between trust and truth judgment. We then apply stress tests by changing only source cues of identical QA between Human and AI. Source attribution shifts not only trust scores but also truth verdicts and logit-derived correct-side probabilities. Results show that current LLM-as-Judge protocols should not treat trust scores as independent evidence for truth judgments.

translated_title: 当信任遇见真相：大语言模型作为评判者中信任与真相的可分离性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21097v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大语言模型作为评判者（LLM-as-Judge）系统能够产生多维度的评估，例如可信度、可靠性和事实性，而这些输出通常被解释为独立证据。我们针对一组常见的判断组合——信任评分和二元真相分类——检验了这一假设。在正确性受控的问答任务中，大语言模型评判者将信任评分与真相判定对齐的程度比人类行为参考更紧密，表明信任与真相判断之间的分离较弱。随后，我们通过仅改变相同问答内容在人类与AI之间的来源线索来进行压力测试。来源归因不仅改变了信任评分，还改变了真相判定以及基于对数概率的正确侧概率。结果表明，当前的大语言模型评判协议不应将信任评分视为真相判断的独立证据。
tldr: 本研究揭示了大语言模型评判中信任评分与真相判定并非独立，来源线索的变化会同时影响两者，因此不应将信任评分作为真相判断的独立证据。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that trust scores and truth verdicts in LLM-as-Judge are not independent, as source cue changes affect both, indicating trust scores should not be treated as independent evidence for truth judgments.
